name: Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act (HB 149)
summary: Texas law regulating development and deployment of AI systems, with prohibitions on certain intentional harmful uses and enforcement by the Attorney General. Signed 22 June 2025 and effective 1 January 2026 per the legislature's bill history. Obligations and the 60-day cure period below come from law-firm summaries, not the statute text.
key_obligations: Prohibits AI systems developed or deployed to incite self-harm or crime, or to unlawfully discriminate, among other listed uses (secondary source)
Attorney General enforcement with written notice and 60-day cure period (secondary source)

timeline.note: Effective date per the bill history page.
